extDescription.message: Capture the current page or a text selection into a Zekra brain as a note.

connectIntro.message: Connect your Zekra account to save pages, notes and secrets straight into a brain.

connectHint.message: Opens Zekra in a new window to sign in and approve access. Nothing is stored except the access token this grant issues.

vaultNote.message: Sealed in the brain's vault. Values are write-only — never read back here.

accessTokenHint.message: The OAuth access token this grant issued. Use it as a Bearer token against the MCP endpoint. Treat it like a password.

workerDown.message: The extension's background worker is not running. Reload the extension.

noWritableBrains.message: This connection has no writable brains. Reconnect and tick a brain with write access.

openingZekraPopup.message: Opening Zekra… finish signing in in the new window. This popup may close; reopen it when you are done.

openingZekra.message: Opening Zekra… finish signing in in the new window.

brainsStillLoading.message: Brains are still loading — try again in a moment.

savingBackground.message: Saving… (you can close this popup — the save continues in the background)

nameValueRequired.message: Name and value are both required.

signInInProgress.message: Sign-in is in progress in the Zekra window — finish there, then reopen this popup.

hostNotGranted.message: Chrome did not grant access to $1.

enterValidBase.message: Enter a valid API base URL first.

errUnreachable.message: Could not reach $1. Check your connection.

errNotConnected.message: Not connected. Connect your Zekra account.

errSessionExpired.message: Your Zekra session expired. Connect again.

errRateLimited.message: Zekra is rate-limiting requests. Wait a moment and try again.

errServer.message: Zekra had a problem ($1). Try again shortly.

errBrainList.message: Could not read the brain list from Zekra

errNoRegistration.message: This Zekra server does not accept new app registrations.

errConnectionEnded.message: Your Zekra connection ended ($1). Connect again.

errRefresh.message: Could not refresh your Zekra session ($1).
